;core_attitudes - Calculation modifier for general relations between factions (diplomacy actions)
;The relevant attitude that is used when deciding whether to accept or deny deals.
;Following the list below, plus -10 for locking ally status:
;CA/Feral documentation:
;Locked Allied		= -10
;DS_ALLIED			= 0
;DS_SUSPICIOUS		= 100
;DS_NEUTRAL			= 200
;DS_HOSTILE			= 400
;DS_AT_WAR			= 600
;Total war			= 850
;Crazy War			= 1000+

;faction_relationships - initial relations
;=<199 Relationship gives Ally (and Trade agreement if possible)
;200 is neutral relationship
;=>201 is War relationship
;Sometimes you can not place the factions in CSV format, there seems to be no logic as to when it can not be done. - verify every addition.

; >>>> spawn scripts rules/mechanism <<<<
;
; - Spawn scripts at the end of this list overrule the scripts at the top.
; - A spawn script for the slave faction will instantly crash the game when it returns true.
; - First declare regular spawn scripts.
; - AFTER this declare event related scripts.
; - Otherwise regular spawn scripts could interfere with events.
; - (eg. Tarentum spawning when the region should have gone to the Roman Empire.
;
